compute_extrinsic_matrix: compute a 4x4 extrinsic matrix from azimuth, elevation, and distance for camera coordinate transforms
project_verts: project 3D vertex positions using a batch of 4x4 projection matrices with perspective division
get_blender_intrinsic_matrix: get the default Blender camera intrinsic matrix as a PyTorch tensor for NDC projection
blender_ndc_to_world: convert normalized device coordinates back to world space by inverting the Blender intrinsic projection
voxel_to_world: transform PyTorch3D Meshes from voxel coordinate space into world coordinate space using ShapeNet z-range constants
